angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 522,540 km at 85.78 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 11.6572 +/- 0.0126 mas (same row, RUWE 1.04): 85.78 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.7511 +/- 0.0346 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1443 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 522,540 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.7663 +/- 0.0234 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1443 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5224 +/- 59 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1443 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1443 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1443.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.571, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-1443: main object type MS*, Main Sequence Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1443 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.294 dex, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1443 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.42022, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1443 (pscomppars): age 7.4 Gyr, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
